Latin word

figūra

figūra, figūrae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a figure of speech; a form of a word, an inflected form; figure, shape; the form of a word; figure of speech, turn of phrase

In this lexicon

  • figure of speech

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 3.53; Cic. Or. 39; Quint. 9.1 (Lewis & Short: “rhet. t. t., a figure of speech”, Greek σχῆμα)

  • form

    the recommended word · classical · Quint. 1.4.29: quaedam tertiae dēmum persōnae figūrā dīcuntur ut licet, piget (Lewis & Short); Varr. LL 9.52; 9.55 (Lewis & Short: “form of a word, inflection”); Traupman 246

  • form

    also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 5.35 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 318: (of a word) figūra; Traupman 29: form (grammatical); Traupman 318

  • idiom

    also used · classical · Traupman 331

  • figūra ōrātiōnis: figure of speech

    modern

Examples

  • quaedam tertiae dēmum persōnae figūrā dīcuntur ut licet, piget

    some are said only in the form of the third person, as licet, pigetQuint. 1.4.29 (Lewis & Short)
